name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.core.BigBrotherDatabaseTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother registers this task when the app starts; when its diagnostic tools are enabled, it prepares a local database for saved sessions and crash reports. It does not open the app's own databases.
disableEffect: BigBrother's local diagnostic records will not be initialized, so saved crash and session details may be unavailable; the app's own data is unaffected.
